answer: Proof-of-personhood gates make a Sybil farm expensive: each agent identity must post a refundable bond scaled to its claimed transaction history, and fresh keys start at zero reputation, so a swarm of clones offers no safe haven from the cost. Payouts route through a shared reputation reef that slashes the whole cluster if any member is caught spawning duplicates, meaning one forged branch drags every linked clone down the canyon with it. Cloning buys nothing but a doubled bill.
